audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of 30 telephone strings covering Robin, Clint, Gus, Pierre, the phone menu and Marnie. Business hours were rendered in 24-hour form; placeholders, gender branches, dialogue markers, sound cues and trailing spacing were preserved.

records.translation: Привіт, це Робін. Наступні кілька днів я буду зайнята роботою над проєктом. *піп*
